everyone can suck it! haha
i'm so surprised how NOT hot it is- I almost need a jacket. the first half day here has been interesting. we took a walk looking for some beer and we didn't find any. the traffic is fucking crazy! they ran across the street, and me trying to be the chill one took my time and ended up in the middle of the street with trucks and cars racing by me. my life flashed before my eyes for a second. the garbage is interesting- not an issue as long as you don't breathe through certain parts. lots of stray dogs and cows.
we saw a dead owl! WTF?? who sees an owl- much less a dead one? haha
